methodology.domainChecks: Authoritative RDAP per TLD (IANA bootstrap endpoints). Each registry was validated against a positive control domain before use, and a 404 is only read as 'unregistered' when the response is a genuine RDAP error document. The public redirector rdap.org was deliberately excluded after it returned a false 404 for google.io.
methodology.webChecks: Bing HTML search, exact phrase and chess-context queries, per candidate.
methodology.trademarkChecks: Official databases probed once each (see trademarkProbes). Per-candidate screening of the official registers was not possible in this environment, so a third-party aggregator search was used as a weak screen and every candidate is marked Unverified in the official registers.
methodology.socialChecks: YouTube handle 404/200, Apple App Store public search API, Google Play search token presence. Other platforms expose no reliable availability signal.
methodology.dice: No domain was registered, purchased, or modified. No external service was written to.
